units.title: 名词与冠词
units.rule: 第一次提到用 a/an；再次提到同一对象用 the。可数名词复数或不可数名词表泛指时不加冠词。
points: 可数名词单数前必须有冠词或限定词：a book / the book / my book
不可数名词（information, advice, luggage, water）不加 a/an，也不加 -s
球类运动、三餐、语言名称前通常用零冠词：play basketball, have lunch, learn English

examples.en: I saw a dog. The dog was barking at me.
examples.note: 第一次提到用 a；再次提到同一只狗用 the 表特指。

examples.en: She plays basketball after school.
examples.note: 球类运动前用零冠词，不加 the。

examples.en: Water is important for life.
examples.note: 不可数名词表泛指时不加冠词；若说 the water in the glass 才用 the。

questions.prompt: Can you give me ___ advice on how to study English?
questions.explain: advice 是不可数名词，前面不能加 a/an；表示“一条建议”用 a piece of advice。

questions.prompt: I saw ___ elephant in the zoo yesterday.
questions.explain: elephant 以元音音素开头，泛指时用 an；first time mention 用不定冠词。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
questions.explain: 球类运动名词前用零冠词：play basketball / play football，不加 the。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: I bought a umbrella.
questions.explain: 第一次提到用 a/an；再次提到同一对象用 the。可数名词复数或不可数名词表泛指时不加冠词。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite: I bought a book. The book is useful.
questions.answer: The book I bought is useful.
questions.explain: 第一次提到用 a/an；再次提到同一对象用 the。可数名词复数或不可数名词表泛指时不加冠词。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 代词体系
units.rule: 形容词性物主代词（my, your）+ 名词；名词性物主代词（mine, yours）单独使用，不能跟名词。
points: 主格做主语：She likes music. 宾格做宾语：Tom helped me.
形容词性物主代词后必须接名词：my book；名词性物主代词独立使用：The book is mine.
反身代词：主语与宾语指向同一人时用 myself / himself / themselves 等
常用不定代词：someone 有人，nothing 没什么，everything 一切，none 一个也没有

examples.en: This is not my pen. Mine is on the desk.
examples.note: my 后接名词 pen；mine 单独使用指代“我的（钢笔）”。

examples.en: He taught himself to cook.
examples.note: 主语 he 与宾语同为人，用反身代词 himself。

examples.en: There is nothing in the box.
examples.note: nothing 是否定意义的不定代词，谓语用单数 is。

questions.prompt: The pen is not mine. It is ___ .
questions.explain: 横线后没有名词，需用名词性物主代词 hers（她的），her 是形容词性物主代词，后面要接名词。

questions.prompt: The children enjoyed ___ at the party.
questions.explain: enjoy oneself 是固定搭配“玩得开心”，主语 the children 对应反身代词 themselves。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
options: My friend and I goes to the park.
My friend and I went to the park.
Me and my friend went to the park.
My friend and me went to the park.
questions.answer: My friend and I went to the park.
questions.explain: 作主语用 I；My friend and I 是复数主语，不接 goes。并列顺序涉及礼貌风格，不是本题的错误判据。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: Me like science.
questions.explain: 形容词性物主代词（my, your）+ 名词；名词性物主代词（mine, yours）单独使用，不能跟名词。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite using a possessive pronoun: This notebook belongs to me.
questions.explain: 形容词性物主代词（my, your）+ 名词；名词性物主代词（mine, yours）单独使用，不能跟名词。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 形容词与副词
units.rule: 单音节与部分双音节词加 -er/-est（tall→taller→tallest）；多音节词用 more/most（beautiful→more beautiful）。
points: 形容词修饰名词（a beautiful girl）；副词修饰动词（run quickly）
不规则变化：good/well→better→best；bad/badly→worse→worst；many/much→more→most
比较级标志词 than；最高级前通常加 the，且常有范围 in/of

examples.en: This book is more interesting than that one.
examples.note: interesting 是多音节词，比较级用 more + 原级，不用 interestinger。

examples.en: She is the tallest student in our class.
examples.note: 最高级前用 the，范围用 in + 集体。

examples.en: He runs faster than before.
examples.note: fast 是单音节副词，比较级直接加 -er：faster。

questions.prompt: This question is ___ than that one.
questions.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more difficult；有 than 表明是比较级。

questions.prompt: She is ___ student in our class.
questions.explain: “全班最高”用最高级，前加 the：the tallest student。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
options: He is gooder at math than me.
He is better at math than me.
He is more good at math than me.
He is best at math than me.
questions.answer: He is better at math than me.
questions.explain: good 的比较级是不规则的 better，不能用 gooder 或 more good。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: She speaks careful.
questions.explain: 单音节与部分双音节词加 -er/-est（tall→taller→tallest）；多音节词用 more/most（beautiful→more beautiful）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite with a comparative: This task is easy. The other task is less easy.
questions.answer: This task is easier than the other task.
questions.explain: 单音节与部分双音节词加 -er/-est（tall→taller→tallest）；多音节词用 more/most（beautiful→more beautiful）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 时态基础：一般现在时与一般过去时
units.rule: 一般现在时三单加 -s/-es（go→goes, study→studies）；一般过去时规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词需记忆（go→went, take→took）。
points: 一般现在时表习惯/事实/真理，常与 every day, usually, often 连用
第三人称单数（he/she/it）作主语时，动词必须加 -s/-es
一般过去时常与 last night, yesterday, ago 连用，动词用过去式
否定与疑问：一般现在时用 do/does，一般过去时用 did（动词还原）

examples.en: My father goes to work by bus every day.
examples.note: 主语 my father 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词加 -s：go→goes。

examples.en: I watched a movie last night.
examples.note: last night 是过去时间标志，动词用过去式 watched。

examples.en: She didn't come to school yesterday.
examples.note: 否定句用 didn't + 动词原形 come，过去式不再保留。

questions.prompt: My sister ___ to school by bike every day.
questions.explain: every day 是一般现在时标志，主语 my sister 为三单，动词用 goes。

questions.prompt: I ___ my homework last night.
questions.explain: last night 表示过去时间，动词用过去式 finished。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
questions.explain: 否定句用 doesn't + 动词原形：doesn't like；likes 要还原为 like。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: Yesterday he walk to school.
questions.explain: 一般现在时三单加 -s/-es（go→goes, study→studies）；一般过去时规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词需记忆（go→went, take→took）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the past: They play tennis every Friday.
questions.explain: 一般现在时三单加 -s/-es（go→goes, study→studies）；一般过去时规则动词加 -ed，不规则动词需记忆（go→went, take→took）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 进行时与完成时
units.rule: 进行时标志词：now, look, listen, at the moment；完成时标志词：already, yet, ever, never, since, for, just。
points: 现在进行时表此刻正在进行的动作：Look! They are playing football.
现在完成时表过去发生但对现在有影响：I have finished my homework.（现在可以交）
since + 时间点，for + 时间段：since 2020 / for two years
短暂性动词（come, leave, buy）不与 for/since 直接连用，常转为 have been/owned 等

examples.en: Look! The children are playing in the yard.
examples.note: look 表示“看”，提示动作正在进行，用are + playing。

examples.en: I have lived here for two years.
examples.note: for two years 表示持续到现在的时段，用现在完成时 have lived。

examples.en: She has already finished her report.
examples.note: already 常与完成时连用，放在 have/has 与过去分词之间。

questions.prompt: Listen! Someone ___ the piano upstairs.
questions.explain: listen 提示声音正在进行，用现在进行时 is playing。

questions.prompt: I ___ in this city since 2020.
questions.explain: since 2020 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时 have lived。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
questions.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went/goed；主语 she 用 has。has gone to 表示“去了还没回来”。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: She has went home.
questions.explain: 进行时标志词：now, look, listen, at the moment；完成时标志词：already, yet, ever, never, since, for, just。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite using since: I moved here in 2020 and still live here.
questions.explain: 进行时标志词：now, look, listen, at the moment；完成时标志词：already, yet, ever, never, since, for, just。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 被动语态
units.rule: 被动语态的时态体现在 be 上：is spoken（一般现在）、was built（一般过去）、will be held（将来）、has been done（完成）。
points: 主动→被动：宾语提前作主语，动词变 be + 过去分词
一般现在时被动：am/is/are + done；一般过去时被动：was/were + done
情态动词被动：can/must/should + be + done
感官动词/使役动词后不定式省略 to，被动时补回：make sb do → be made to do

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.note: 一般现在时被动：is + spoken，动作执行者不明时省略 by。

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.note: 一般过去时被动：was + built（build→built→built）。

examples.en: The room must be kept clean.
examples.note: 情态动词被动：must + be + kept。

questions.prompt: English ___ all over the world.
questions.explain: English 是动作承受者，用被动语态；一般现在时被动为 is spoken。

questions.prompt: The Great Wall ___ by thousands of tourists every year.
questions.explain: 长城被参观，用一般现在时被动 is visited。

questions.prompt: 主动句 “They clean the room every day.” 改为被动语态：
options: The room is cleaned every day.
The room was cleaned every day.
The room is cleaning every day.
questions.answer: The room is cleaned every day.
questions.explain: every day 为一般现在时，被动结构 is cleaned；时态要保留原句的一般现在。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: The samples was collected yesterday.
questions.explain: 被动语态的时态体现在 be 上：is spoken（一般现在）、was built（一般过去）、will be held（将来）、has been done（完成）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite in the passive: They clean the classroom every day.
questions.answer: The classroom is cleaned every day.
questions.explain: 被动语态的时态体现在 be 上：is spoken（一般现在）、was built（一般过去）、will be held（将来）、has been done（完成）。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 情态动词
units.rule: 常见核心情态动词 can/could/may/might/must/should 后接原形；ought to 和 have to 的结构另记。禁止 must not 与不必 need not 意义不同。
points: can/could：能力与许可（Can I use your phone?）
may/might：许可与可能性（may 语气更正式）
must：必须（主观义务）与肯定推测（must be 一定是）；否定 mustn't 表禁止
should/ought to：应该（建议、义务）；needn't 表“不必”

examples.en: He must be at home; the light is on.
examples.note: 灯亮着，做出肯定推测用 must be（一定是）。

examples.en: You should see a doctor if you feel unwell.
examples.note: 建议用 should + 动词原形 see。

examples.en: Must I finish it today? No, you needn't.
examples.note: must 提问，否定回答用 needn't（不必），而非 mustn't（禁止）。

questions.prompt: ___ I borrow your dictionary? — Sure, here you are.
questions.explain: 请求许可用 Can/May/Could I…?；must 表必须，不用于借东西的请求。

questions.prompt: School rules require this: You ___ finish your homework before going out.
questions.explain: 表示“必须”（义务）用 must；can't 表禁止/不可能，语气不当。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
questions.explain: 情态动词后接动词原形，且无人称变化：He can sing well.。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: He can to swim.
questions.explain: 常见核心情态动词 can/could/may/might/must/should 后接原形；ought to 和 have to 的结构另记。禁止 must not 与不必 need not 意义不同。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Rewrite as advice: It is a good idea to check your answer.
questions.explain: 常见核心情态动词 can/could/may/might/must/should 后接原形；ought to 和 have to 的结构另记。禁止 must not 与不必 need not 意义不同。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 定语从句
units.rule: 限定性从句中 who/that 可指人，which/that 可指物；非限定性从句不用 that。作宾语的关系代词在限定性从句中常可省略，作主语不能省略。
points: who 指人，作主语：The man who is talking to Mary is my uncle.
which 指物，作主语或宾语：This is the book which I bought yesterday.
that 可指人或物，常与 who/which 互换；介词后不用 that 而用 which/whom
关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省略：the book (that) I read

examples.en: The girl who wears glasses is my sister.
examples.note: 先行词 the girl 指人，用 who 引导并在从句中作主语。

examples.en: This is the movie which we watched last week.
examples.note: the movie 指物，用 which（也可用 that）引导，在从句中作宾语。

examples.en: The house whose roof is red belongs to my aunt.
examples.note: 表示所属关系用 whose：房子的屋顶（the house's roof）。

questions.prompt: The man ___ is standing at the door is my teacher.
questions.explain: 先行词 the man 指人，且关系代词在从句中作主语，用 who。

questions.prompt: This is the book ___ I bought yesterday.
questions.explain: 先行词 the book 指物，用 which（或 that）；I bought 缺宾语，which 作宾语。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的句子：
options: The boy which is singing is my brother.
The boy who is singing is my brother.
The boy who he is singing is my brother.
The boy whom is singing is my brother.
questions.answer: The boy who is singing is my brother.
questions.explain: 指人的先行词用 who；who 已在从句中作主语，不能再加 he；whom 只能作宾语。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: The student who she won is smiling.
questions.answer: The student who won is smiling.
questions.explain: 限定性从句中 who/that 可指人，which/that 可指物；非限定性从句不用 that。作宾语的关系代词在限定性从句中常可省略，作主语不能省略。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.prompt: Combine: I met a teacher. The teacher speaks Spanish.
questions.answer: I met a teacher who speaks Spanish.
questions.explain: 限定性从句中 who/that 可指人，which/that 可指物；非限定性从句不用 that。作宾语的关系代词在限定性从句中常可省略，作主语不能省略。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 主谓一致
units.rule: 主语的数决定谓语；介词短语不能代替主语。
points: 主语的数决定谓语；介词短语不能代替主语。

examples.en: The box of pencils is on the shelf.

units.title: 疑问与否定
units.rule: 一般现在、过去时用 do/does/did，后接动词原形；be 和情态动词直接提前。
points: 一般现在、过去时用 do/does/did，后接动词原形；be 和情态动词直接提前。

examples.en: Did you finish the experiment?
examples.note: 一般现在、过去时用 do/does/did，后接动词原形；be 和情态动词直接提前。

questions.prompt: ___ she work here every day?
questions.explain: 一般现在、过去时用 do/does/did，后接动词原形；be 和情态动词直接提前。

questions.prompt: He did not ___ the bus yesterday.

questions.prompt: Correct the error: Did she finished the task?

units.title: 数量与限定词
units.rule: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。
points: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。

examples.en: There is very little water left.
examples.note: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。

questions.prompt: There is not ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explain: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。

questions.prompt: We have ___ chairs for all ten guests: twelve chairs.
questions.explain: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。

questions.prompt: Correct the error: There are much books here.
questions.explain: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

questions.answer: There is a little water left.
questions.explain: many/few 配可数复数，much/little 配不可数；a few/a little 表有一些。 参考答案仅是一种表达；核对意义、结构与标点，允许其他合理答案。

units.title: 时间与地点介词
units.rule: at 用于时刻，on 用于具体日期，in 用于月份年份；固定搭配需结合语境。
points: at 用于时刻，on 用于具体日期，in 用于月份年份；固定搭配需结合语境。

examples.en: The meeting starts at nine on Monday.
examples.note: at 用于时刻，on 用于具体日期，in 用于月份年份；固定搭配需结合语境。

questions.prompt: The meeting starts ___ nine o’clock.
questions.explain: at 用于时刻，on 用于具体日期，in 用于月份年份；固定搭配需结合语境。
